key.name: source
key.description: Which machine the panel button is currently showing: 'local' or 'remote'. Persisted so the choice survives a Shell restart.

key.name: remote-host
key.description: Host or IP running the Glances web/API agent. Empty until configured, in which case the remote source reports itself as unconfigured rather than failing to connect.

key.name: remote-label
key.summary: Short name shown in the panel for the remote source

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: Only the active source is polled, so switching sources does not double the work.

key.name: panel-show-aux
key.summary: Show temperature, or io/steal on a VM, in the panel

key.name: panel-show-gpu
key.description: Local source only, and only when a GPU is actually detected.

key.name: panel-show-net
key.summary: Show network throughput in the panel
